implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.__init__ creates a grid with default rows=6, cols=7 (board.py).
Game.players holds two Player objects and Game.switch_player toggles current_player (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Players choose columns by typing a number
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player.get_move prompts with input() and returns a zero‑based column index (player.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Validate column choices (range, numeric, not full)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player.get_move checks raw.isdecimal(), range bounds, and board.is_valid_column() (player.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Drop disc into the lowest empty cell of the chosen column
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.drop_disc iterates from bottom row upward and places the disc (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Update and display the board after each move
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.play calls board.display() after each drop_disc (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line of four discs
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.check_win scans in four directions using _count_direction and returns True when count >= 4 (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: End the game when a win is detected
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.play breaks the loop after board.check_win returns True and calls _announce_win (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: End the game when the grid is full (draw)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.play checks board.is_full() and breaks with _announce_draw (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Graceful handling of EOF or interrupt
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py catches EOFError and KeyboardInterrupt around game.play and input for rematch (main.py).

judge.summary: All core Connect Four features are present: a 7x6 board, two alternating players, validated numeric column input, disc dropping, board rendering, win/draw detection, and graceful termination. The code appears syntactically correct and likely runnable as provided.
